title: City — Interesting Things the Place Can Offer

entries.value: Expensive urban property — a warehouse, a town house
Sophisticated and very valuable local products
Formal citizenship and the rights of a local
Quiet dismissal of criminal charges or disgraceful pasts
Indulgences beyond the power of a smaller place to grant
Services of exceptionally skilled specialist craftsmen
Connections with major nobility of the realm
Absentee ownership of rural manors or farms
Rare occult components or magical products
Blessings from major clergy or high priests
Business monopolies or toll-rights in certain areas
